items.detail: All six door/pantry combinations retain the specified 5 x 6 ft block.
Each M186 search either passes its full contract or is explicitly rejected because the pantry blocks the fixed route start/goal gate before grid expansion.
A remains a route obstacle and has zero pantry/route overlap; B remains an obstacle and unassigned.
All tested pantry footprints remain outside the dining room block; the 6-in dining shift is reported separately.
All test rectangles use the 5 x 6 ft (30 sf) kitchen specification; the 5 x 7 ft M04 source mismatch remains disclosed.

limitations: Only three positions are tested; this is not an exhaustive pantry-location search.
Door leaf, rough opening, swing, shelving, work aisles, storage fit, service routes and wall thickness are not modeled. The shared-wall lengths of 30 in and 36 in do not prove a door fits.
The 40 x 42 ft shell and all room/furniture blocks are schematic proxies; the pantry dimensions conflict across sources; this run tests the 5 x 6 ft kitchen target.
A pantry position overlapping M-06/A consumes unassigned bath-search area and is a trade-off, not an assignment. B remains unassigned and protected.
No code, accessibility, structural, permit, professional or construction-readiness conclusion follows. Revit, IFC, selected-D and RFAs are unchanged.
